newsitem.title: DENMARK: HSBC/Capel downgrades Novo Nordisk EPS.
newsitem.headline: HSBC/Capel downgrades Novo Nordisk EPS.

text.p: Investmemt bank HSBC James Capel said on Friday that it was downgrading its earning per share (EPS) forecasts for Danish pharmaceutical group Novo Nordisk to hold.
HSBC James Capel said at the same time that it maintained its "hold" recommendation for the Novo share.
It attributed its EPS downgrading to research and development expenditure and worries about growth in Novo Nordisk's key U.S. insulin market.
It said it lowered Novo's EPS to 26.9 Danish crowns from a previous 28.9 crowns, with the 1998 EPS expectation for the biotechnological group cut to 31.2 crowns from 32.7 crowns.
On Wednesday Novo Nordisk reported a 10 percent rise in net profit for the first half of 1997 to 960 million crowns and repeated a forecast of 15 percent growth in operating income for the full year.
